text:
Chip Fields played **Rochelle**, one of J.J.'s girlfriends, in "J.J.'s New Career, Part 2" (Season 4, aired November 17, 1976). Wikipedia, TVmaze, and TheTVDB agree, and a fresh search found nothing supporting the team note's "Penny" or "Thelma," so I'm keeping Rochelle. Penny Gordon's mother, Lynnetta Gordon, was a later role for Fields, not this episode.

CONFIDENCE: 88
